summary: TELA Bio, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration granted 510(k) clearance for its Liora Monofilament Scaffold, a fully resorbable surgical mesh for soft tissue reinforcement. The product is the first implant fully developed in the company's ISO 8 certified cleanroom in Malvern, Pennsylvania. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. Management said further details will be provided on the third-quarter earnings call expected in early November. This is a routine product-regulatory milestone, not a special situation; watch commercialization launch timing and reimbursement.
